_info: Battlefield looks (diorama): light, fog and palette by time of day. A scenario picks one with "look" (default morning). Two approved variants (visual prototype, phase 2): morning = clear daylight, afternoon = late warm light; both use the same materials. sun = [pitch°, yaw°], colours as hex. ground = meadow colours (two for soft patches), ground_dark = darker patches, bank = sand of the river bank, path = worn path to the bridge (path_strength 0..1), planks = bridge deck, cliff = the diorama's rock walls (top, ledge, bottom), water = shallow/deep/foam, leaves = tree colours, fog = fog colour and density, bg = background gradient (top, bottom). grade = saturation, contrast, brightness. shadow_opacity, shadow_blur = sun shadow. ssao (bool), ssao_intensity = optional contact occlusion.
